title: machine-intent
description: NX-062 M5c (design §4, R4): the state of one machine write intent - the answer of POST /machine/v1/commit (200; 202 while waiting for approval) and of GET /machine/v1/intents/{intent_id}. phase: prepare, pending_approval (an approval was opened; commit again with the same intent after it is approved), committed (outcome_id is the governed outcome) or refused (result_code a fixed code, e.g. not_permitted when the grant, scope or allowlist no longer allows it at commit). A finished intent answers its first result to the same commit (replayed true), even after the prepare's expiry. After a network error or an unknown result the client queries the intent before committing again. Codes and ids only: never parameters or text; approval_status is the approval's state, never who decided. NexLoop target contract; server-derived identity required.
